title: fix(zoomit): prevent skipped frames in screen recordings

review.body_prefix:
### Review assessment

The current source introduces FIFO frame delivery with shared leases, resets frame notifications under the producer lock, discards startup frames before choosing the recording time origin, and configures sample duration and encoder rate control explicitly. The new tests target queued-frame delivery, lease validity/order, timed animation and shutdown.

The assessed feedback did not establish an additional required code correction. The proposed shared-lock/GUID changes were optional. A lifetime concern based on revocation alone was not demonstrated against the complete end-signal/revoke/session-close/frame-pool-close path; this is not a claim that destructor/callback stress has passed.

**Validation scope:** Exact source and test/project integration were inspected, and the changed project XML parsed successfully. No native product build, interactive capture test, recording playback test or shutdown stress test was executed. Those runtime outcomes are not certified by this assessment.

No additional code change is requested by this focused assessment. This is a qualified summary, not an unconditional approval.
